QUOTE: Its init, `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` (line 566), zeroes the static heap, sets the calloc/free pair to its own functions through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` (lines 572 and 575)... This is the only place the library installs an allocator itself.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as installing its own calloc/free via the runtime setter, and says it is the only in-tree place that does so.
